selection.rule: next ten preserved baseline addresses after accepted Batch 004

decisions.contact_path: Current storage scanning, ZIP intake, private data handling, and trust-zone separation already rely on policy boundaries that are only partially enforced in technical data flows.
decisions.rationale: The affected privacy and storage paths are active current capabilities. Policy-only trust-zone enforcement is therefore a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Bug Memory, private Notes workspaces, catalog packs, and Notes handoff are verified current capabilities whose completeness and synchronization depend on manual actions.
decisions.rationale: The manual boundary is already part of current project operation. Missing completeness and synchronization proof is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Multi-device and concurrent-edit conflicts become operational when current local, Notes, or GitHub records are edited from overlapping sessions or devices.
decisions.rationale: The project has current persistence and external handoff surfaces, but no evidence proves overlapping multi-device editing is part of the present baseline. The risk is active conditional on that contact.

decisions.contact_path: Current work-thread, truth, inventory, write, and safety records use timestamps, ordering, receipts, or approval-like evidence without one trusted monotonic ordering source.
decisions.rationale: Ordering and evidence identity already affect current project records. Missing trusted sequencing is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current truth reports, inventory records, Safe Writer transactions, and Code Safety evidence are stored without a uniformly tamper-evident append-only ledger implementation.
decisions.rationale: Evidence and receipt records already govern current safety claims. Missing tamper evidence is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current Resident, storage, Bug Memory, and private data surfaces collect and retain user/project information without complete minimization, consent, retention display, export, and deletion controls in the UI.
decisions.rationale: The data is already present in current capabilities, so the missing user controls are a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current private Bug Memory, exported packs, Notes transfer, ZIP intake, and optional backend configuration can contain private project data or secrets without encryption-at-rest and backup-secret proof.
decisions.rationale: Private exports and local records already exist. Missing encryption and secret-handling proof is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current project truth and inventory governance can still encounter the preserved stale Note 01 packet order that conflicts with the executed packet sequence.
decisions.rationale: The conflicting governance record remains part of the current project record set and can misdirect work unless precedence is enforced. It is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current roadmap and truth surfaces must account for Packet 06.5, while the preserved Note 01 record omits it.
decisions.rationale: The omission conflicts with the current approved sequence and can affect active project decisions. It is a current governance defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current completion, receipt, and final closure governance requires Packet 26, while the preserved Note 01 record omits it.
decisions.rationale: The omission can misstate the active project sequence and closure authority. It is a current governance defect.

routing_fields_rule: All destination, law, watch-trigger, and semantic-cluster fields remain blank in this batch.
source_preservation_rule: All immutable source fields, addresses, source hashes, original wording, accepted prior classifications, and total envelope count remain unchanged except for the ten selected applicability fields.
